title: Israeli Strikes Kill 19 Across Gaza — Largest Daily Toll in Weeks
detail: Israeli strikes killed at least 19 Palestinians across Gaza on August 2, 2026 — the largest single-day death toll in weeks, according to Palestinian health officials, coming days after Trump's announced Hamas disarmament agreement. An air raid on a residential apartment in Al-Sousi Tower, western Gaza City, killed Abdullah Abu Taif (33), his pregnant wife Abeer Anan (29), and their 5-year-old son Azzam. A strike on an apartment in al-Qarara, northwest of Khan Younis, killed three members of the Al-Hams family: father Mahmoud (38), wife Fatima (37), and their young daughter. An elderly couple, Kamu Abu Muailiq (68) and his wife Huda (59), were killed near Deir al-Balah. Two brothers were killed on a motorbike; a drone strike on a displaced-persons' tent in the Remal neighborhood killed 2; a strike on a vehicle in Gaza City killed 4 more; and additional deaths were reported in Jabalia refugee camp and al-Mawasi.

title: IDF Kills PIJ Commander Who Held Hostage Rom Braslavski, Plus 2 Hamas Militants
detail: The IDF announced it killed Mahmoud Fatair, a Palestinian Islamic Jihad commander in the PIJ's Central Gaza Brigade, in a strike on the Deir al-Balah area over the weekend of August 1–2, 2026. The military said Fatair took part in the October 7, 2023 Nova festival attack and held released hostage Rom Braslavski captive for 738 days until his October 2025 release, and had recently been advancing plans to attack IDF troops and Israeli civilians. In separate strikes the same weekend, the IDF also killed two Hamas military-wing members: Abdallah Adnan Taha Abu al-Tayf, described as a Nukhba commander, in central Gaza, and Jalal Tsubeih, a Daraj Tuffah Battalion commander, in the Shati refugee camp in Gaza City.
